# Notice and asset provenance

## Project

Modeling & Research Figure Skill, 2026.

This community project is not affiliated with Nature Portfolio, COMAP, CUMCM, or any mathematical-modeling competition organizer.

## Asset groups

### Runnable modeling templates

The 16 files under `assets/previews/modeling-templates/`, their SVG counterparts, and the generators under `scripts/` were independently reconstructed with deterministic demonstration data. Their source-reference screenshots are included separately and are never claimed as hidden-data reproductions.

### Contributor-curated modeling examples

The four `math-a-*` / `math-b-*` examples were curated and provided by a project contributor. They are illustrative examples, not actual contest submissions or claims of competition results. They are included for public redistribution with the repository publisher's permission.

### Research chart atlases and multi-panel mockups

The 10 chart-atlas previews and 5 multi-panel mockups are renamed copies of assets from `Yuan1z0825/nature-skills`, released under Apache-2.0. The verified upstream revision is `a6e6f3456f2065eb555afe8ed2c28637f3cd4e1b`:

https://github.com/Yuan1z0825/nature-skills

Original paths and renamed groups:

- `skills/nature-figure/assets/chart-atlas/atlas-01-*.png` through `atlas-10-*.png` → `assets/previews/chart-atlas/research-atlas-*.png`
- `skills/nature-figure/assets/gallery/fig1-material-mechanism-rich.png` → `research-blueprint-material.png`
- `skills/nature-figure/assets/gallery/fig2-spatial-imaging-rich.png` → `research-blueprint-imaging.png`
- `skills/nature-figure/assets/gallery/fig3-in-vivo-efficacy-rich.png` → `research-blueprint-clinical.png`
- `skills/nature-figure/assets/gallery/fig4-single-cell-systems-rich.png` → `research-blueprint-single-cell.png`
- `skills/nature-figure/assets/gallery/fig5-validation-perturbation-rich.png` → `research-blueprint-validation.png`

The upstream project describes the multi-panel assets as simulated-data mockups. They must not be presented as real experiments. Renaming `nature-*` files to `research-*` avoids implying affiliation with Nature Portfolio.

### Source references and QA comparisons

The 11 unique screenshots under `assets/source-references/` were supplied for this project and explicitly authorized for inclusion in the public Skill. One duplicate screenshot was deduplicated. The 9 files under `assets/qa-comparisons/` combine those references with independently generated outputs for visual QA. They are documentation assets, not data-replaceable templates.

Except where an upstream notice says otherwise, repository content is distributed under the Apache License 2.0.
